title: Pepsi Once Owned 17 Soviet Submarines #shorts
description:
In 1989, the Soviet ruble could not be converted into dollars, so Pepsi took payment in ships. The deal reportedly gave Pepsi 17 old submarines plus a cruiser, a frigate and a destroyer. The famous line that Pepsi became the world's sixth-largest navy is a joke, not a fact: Pepsi never ran a fleet, and reportedly sold the ships for scrap to a Norwegian company.
